design: Eight triples, three role rotations, two givers, three distractor placements =144 prompts. Only two people go to market; third stays home. Giver changes within each paired block.
competence: Three-way and full-vocabulary accuracy, recipient-vs-distractor accuracy excluding giver, and both-giver block accuracy. Strong gate >=75% paired blocks and >=50% full-top1 per format.
intervention: Neutralize one named source/head contribution to mean of the three name-value vectors, then run downstream normally. Same frozen four heads, no reselection.
hypotheses: Natural binding distinguishes recipient from an irrelevant third person where arbitrary mapping is unreliable.
An association-selective reader should favor recipient over distractor even when distractor is more recent.
Giver suppression alone cannot determine the recipient among two nongiver candidates.
scope: Declared natural-language expectation and model competence, not a logical guarantee that a parcel could never reach an absent person. Source/head-local effects, not whole-circuit ablation.
